name: page-reload-request
description: A page that applies a plugin change asks the host to reload it with pageReload and the operation of the change, and the host answers at once.
reason: The reload that the call starts ends the page, so the producer, which runs one page per case, plays no call that ends its page; the host side of pageReload is covered by the host tests of the case application.page-reload.requested-by-the-page.
